cards.audioText: [Your call sign is ACA554, from Wuhan to Vancouver, pushback and start-up have been completed, request Wuhan Ground for taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你的呼号是加航554，从武汉飞往温哥华，已经完成推出开车，向武汉地面请求滑行指令]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA554, pushback and start up completed, request taxi instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航554，已经完成推出开车，请求滑行指令。

cards.audioText: ACA554, Wuhan Ground, taxi to holding point via A7, A, Z4, C.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，武汉地面，经由滑行道A7，A，Z4，C，滑行至等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point via A7, A, Z4, C, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道A7，A，Z4，C，滑行至等待点，加航554。

cards.audioText: ACA554, follow the A319 on M to holding point runway 18R.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，跟随着M上的A319，滑行至跑道18右等待点。
cards.referenceText: Follow the A319 on M to holding point runway 18R, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟随着M上的A319，滑行至跑道18右等待点，加航554。

cards.audioText: ACA554, runway 18R is closed due to disable aircraft on the runway. Change your ATC clearance to runway 18L, ZF-12D departure, the rest is unchanged.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，由于故障航空器，跑道18右关闭。你的放行许可更改至跑道18左，ZF-12D离场，其余指令不变。
cards.referenceText: Runway 18L, ZF-12D departure, rest unchanged, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道18左，ZF-12D离场，其余未变，加航554。

cards.audioText: ACA554, enter runway 18R from C, vacate runway via C4, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，由C进跑道18右，通过C4脱离跑道，脱离后报。
cards.referenceText: Enter runway 18R from C, vacate runway via C4, report vacated, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由C进跑道18右，通过C4脱离跑道，脱离后报，加航554。

cards.audioText: [Now you have vacated runway 18R via C4, report to Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在已经通过C4脱离跑道18右，报告给地面]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA554, vacated runway 18R via C4.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航554，已经通过C4脱离跑道18右。

cards.audioText: ACA554, continue taxi to holding point 18L via M, A, A1
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，继续通过M，A，A1，滑行至跑道18左等待点。
cards.referenceText: Continue taxi to holding point 18L via M, A, A1, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续通过M，A，A1，滑行至跑道18左等待点，加航554。

cards.audioText: [Now you are airborne, climbing to 1800m, you see a helicopter at 10 o'clock above. It is closing to your aircraft. Inform Wuhan Control and ask for a right turn to avoid the traffic.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在离地了，正爬升至1800米，你看到上方10点钟方向上有一架直升机。它正在接近你的飞机。告知武汉区调，请求右转躲避航空器]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA554, airborne, climbing to 1800m, helicopter at 10 o'clock above. It is closing to my aircraft. Request right turn to avoid the traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航554，离地了，正爬升至1800米，上方10点钟方向上有一架直升机。它正在接近我的飞机。请求右转躲避航空器。

cards.audioText: ACA554, roger, turn right heading 240, expedite climb 2400m, maintain visual separation with the helicopter.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，收到，右转航向240，加速爬升至2400米，与直升机保持目视间隔。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, expedite climb 2400m, maintain visual separation with the helicopter, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，加速爬升至2400米，与直升机保持目视间隔，加航554。

cards.audioText: ACA554, after the traffic is clear, track direct to ZF, resume own navigation, climb to and maintain 5100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，与航空器解除冲突后，直飞ZF，恢复自主领航，上5100米保持。
cards.referenceText: After the traffic is clear, track direct to ZF resume own navigation, climb to and maintain 5100m, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 与航空器解除冲突后，直飞ZF，恢复自主领航，上5100米保持，加航554。

cards.audioText: [You are now at cruising level 9500m, over OBLIK, make an initial contact with Zhengzhou Control, your squawk number is 5655.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在到达巡航高度9500米，过OBLIK，与郑州区调做初始联络，你的应答机是5655]
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA554, 9500m, over OBLIK, squawk 5655.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，加航554，9500米，过OBLIK，应答机5655。

cards.audioText: ACA554, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, climb to and maintain 10100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，郑州区调，雷达识别，上10100米保持。

cards.audioText: [Suddenly, your cabin crew reports there are toxic fume in the rear cabin. You decide to expedite descent for smoke removal. Make a distress call to Zhengzhou Control and request to level off at 3000m.]
cards.audioTextZh: [突然，你的乘务员报告客舱后部出现有毒烟雾，你决定加速下降，进行除烟，向郑州区调宣布遇险，并请求在3000米改平]
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Zhengzhou Control, ACA554, toxic fume in the rear cabin, we are expediting descent for smoke removal, request level off at 3000m.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，郑州区调，加航554，客舱后部出现有毒烟雾，我们加速下降，进行除烟，请求在3000米改平。

cards.audioText:
ACA554, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 030, descend to 3000m, QNH1008, advise intentions when able.
[Tell Zhengzhou Control, the toxic fume is caused by dangerous cargo leakage in cargo hold.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航554，收到MAYDAY，右转航向030，下降到3000米，修正海压1008，如可以，告知意图。
[告诉郑州区调，有毒烟雾是由于货舱危险品泄露导致的]
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 030, descend to 3000m, QNH1008, the toxic fume is caused by dangerous cargo leakage in cargo hold, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向030，下降到3000米，修正海压1008，有毒烟雾是由于货舱危险品泄露导致的，加航554。

cards.audioText: [Passengers have been seriously affected by the toxic fume, and become unconscious. Tell Zhengzhou Control the situation and ask for divert to Zhengzhou Airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: [由于有毒烟雾，乘客受到严重影响，失去意识。将情况告知郑州区调，请求改航至郑州机场]
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA554, passengers have been seriously affected by the toxic fume, and become unconscious. Request divert to Zhengzhou Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，加航554，由于有毒烟雾，乘客受到严重影响，失去意识。请求改航至郑州机场。

cards.audioText: ACA554, Zhengzhou Control, roger, turn left heading 360, contact Zhengzhou Approach 120.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，郑州区调，收到，左转航向360，联系郑州进近120.35。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 360, contact Zhengzhou Approach 120.35, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向360，联系郑州进近120.35，加航554。

cards.audioText: ACA554, Zhengzhou Approach, radar contact, track direct to CGO, maintain 3000m, expect radar vectors for ILS runway 12.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，郑州进近，雷达识别，直飞CGO，保持3000米，预计雷达引导，ILS跑道12。
cards.referenceText: Track direct to CGO, maintain 3000m, expect radar vectors for ILS runway 12, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞CGO，保持3000米，预计雷达引导ILS跑道12，加航554。
